_comment: Presenter instructions, keyed by step id. The entry below is an example and is deliberately not a real id — replace the key with the id of the step it belongs to. {{personaId}} expands to that persona's base URL. Anything here can live inline on the step instead, as "manual": { ... } in steps.json, which wins over this file.

do: Use the window signed in as REPLACE_ME.
Click once in the address bar so the existing address is highlighted.
Press Enter and wait about 8 seconds. The numbers load last — do not start talking until the tiles show figures.
example-step-id.expect: A page headed Dashboard with four tiles showing numbers.
example-step-id.recover: If you land on a login screen you are not signed in. Go back to Before you start and sign in again in this window.
